definitions.full: H6855. Tsipporah צִמֹּרָה proper name, feminine wife of Moses ( bird ); — Exod 2:21 ; 4:25 ; 18:2 ; Σεπφωρα (compare Lag BN 90 Anm .*). III. צפר (√ of following; compare Arabic plait, braid , Ethiopic id. ; Late Hebrew צְפִירָהֵ = rim of basket).
